topic: Reported speech (Indirect speech): Reported speech – simple statements
title: Reported Speech: Simple Statements

explanation.tr:
Reported speech (dolaylı anlatım), birinin söylediğini aktarmaktır.
• Direct: Tom said, "I am tired."
• Reported: Tom said (that) he was tired.
Giriş fiili geçmişte ise (said, told) zaman bir adım geriye kayar:
• am/is → was, are → were
• present simple → past simple: "I like tea." → She said she liked tea.
• can → could
Zamirler de değişir: I → he/she, my → his/her, we → they.
• say + (that) ...: He said that ...
• tell + kişi + (that): He told me that ...
explanation.tk:
Reported speech (gytaklaýyn gürrüň) — biriniň aýdanyny gürrüň bermek.
• Göni: Tom said, "I am tired."
• Gytaklaýyn: Tom said (that) he was tired.
Giriş işligi geçmişde bolsa (said, told), zaman bir ädim yza süýşýär:
• am/is → was, are → were
• present simple → past simple: "I like tea." → She said she liked tea.
• can → could
Çalyşmalar hem üýtgeýär: I → he/she, my → his/her, we → they.
• say + (that) ...: He said that ...
• tell + adam + (that): He told me that ...
explanation.ru:
Reported speech (косвенная речь) — передача чужих слов.
• Прямая: Tom said, "I am tired."
• Косвенная: Tom said (that) he was tired.
Если вводный глагол в прошедшем (said, told), время сдвигается на шаг назад:
• am/is → was, are → were
• present simple → past simple: "I like tea." → She said she liked tea.
• can → could
Меняются и местоимения: I → he/she, my → his/her, we → they.
• say + (that) ...: He said that ...
• tell + кому + (that): He told me that ...

topic: Reported speech (Indirect speech): Reported speech – statements with expressions of time
title: Reported Speech: Changing Time and Place Words

explanation.tr:
Dolaylı anlatımda zaman ve yer bildiren kelimeler de değişir, çünkü konuşma artık başka bir zamanda aktarılıyor.
• now → then
• today → that day
• tonight → that night
• yesterday → the day before / the previous day
• tomorrow → the next day / the following day
• last week → the week before
• next week → the following week
• ago → before
• here → there, this → that, these → those
Örnek: "I'm leaving tomorrow." → He said he was leaving the next day.
explanation.tk:
Gytaklaýyn gürrüňde wagt we ýer görkezýän sözler hem üýtgeýär, sebäbi gürrüň başga wagtda berilýär.
• now → then
• today → that day
• tonight → that night
• yesterday → the day before / the previous day
• tomorrow → the next day / the following day
• last week → the week before
• next week → the following week
• ago → before
• here → there, this → that, these → those
Mysal: "I'm leaving tomorrow." → He said he was leaving the next day.
explanation.ru:
В косвенной речи меняются и слова времени и места, потому что слова передаются в другое время.
• now → then
• today → that day
• tonight → that night
• yesterday → the day before / the previous day
• tomorrow → the next day / the following day
• last week → the week before
• next week → the following week
• ago → before
• here → there, this → that, these → those
Пример: "I'm leaving tomorrow." → He said he was leaving the next day.

topic: Reported speech (Indirect speech): Reported speech – will-future – Sentences
title: Reported Speech: will → would

explanation.tr:
Gelecek zaman 'will' dolaylı anlatımda 'would' olur.
• "I will help you." → She said she would help me.
• "I won't be late." → He said he wouldn't be late.
• "It will rain tomorrow." → They said it would rain the next day.
'going to' da geçmişe kayar:
• "I'm going to buy a car." → He said he was going to buy a car.
Zaman ve zamir değişikliklerini unutma: tomorrow → the next day, I → he/she.
explanation.tk:
Geljek zaman 'will' gytaklaýyn gürrüňde 'would' bolýar.
• "I will help you." → She said she would help me.
• "I won't be late." → He said he wouldn't be late.
• "It will rain tomorrow." → They said it would rain the next day.
'going to' hem geçmişe süýşýär:
• "I'm going to buy a car." → He said he was going to buy a car.
Wagt we çalyşma üýtgeşmelerini ýatdan çykarma: tomorrow → the next day, I → he/she.
explanation.ru:
Будущее время 'will' в косвенной речи становится 'would'.
• "I will help you." → She said she would help me.
• "I won't be late." → He said he wouldn't be late.
• "It will rain tomorrow." → They said it would rain the next day.
'going to' тоже сдвигается в прошлое:
• "I'm going to buy a car." → He said he was going to buy a car.
Не забывай про слова времени и местоимения: tomorrow → the next day, I → he/she.

topic: Reported speech (Indirect speech): Reported speech in different English tenses
title: Reported Speech: Backshift in All Tenses

explanation.tr:
Dolaylı anlatımda her zaman bir adım geriye kayar (backshift):
• present simple → past simple (I work → he worked)
• present progressive → past progressive (I am working → he was working)
• present perfect → past perfect (I have finished → he had finished)
• past simple → past perfect (I saw → he had seen)
• will → would, can → could, may → might, must → had to
• past perfect değişmez.
Genel gerçekler değişmeyebilir: "The Earth is round." → He said the Earth is round.
explanation.tk:
Gytaklaýyn gürrüňde her zaman bir ädim yza süýşýär (backshift):
• present simple → past simple (I work → he worked)
• present progressive → past progressive (I am working → he was working)
• present perfect → past perfect (I have finished → he had finished)
• past simple → past perfect (I saw → he had seen)
• will → would, can → could, may → might, must → had to
• past perfect üýtgemeýär.
Umumy hakykatlar üýtgemän biler: "The Earth is round." → He said the Earth is round.
explanation.ru:
В косвенной речи каждое время сдвигается на шаг назад (backshift):
• present simple → past simple (I work → he worked)
• present progressive → past progressive (I am working → he was working)
• present perfect → past perfect (I have finished → he had finished)
• past simple → past perfect (I saw → he had seen)
• will → would, can → could, may → might, must → had to
• past perfect не меняется.
Общеизвестные истины могут не меняться: "The Earth is round." → He said the Earth is round.

topic: Sentences, Word order and Conjunctions: Conjunctions, connecting words of time in English sentences
title: Time Conjunctions: when, while, before, after, until, as soon as

explanation.tr:
Zaman bağlaçları iki olayı zaman açısından bağlar:
• when — -dığında: When I arrived, she was cooking.
• while — -iken (uzun süren eylem): While I was reading, the phone rang.
• before — -meden önce: Wash your hands before you eat.
• after — -dikten sonra: After he finished, he went home.
• until / till — -e kadar: Wait until I come.
• as soon as — -ir -mez: Call me as soon as you arrive.
Gelecek anlamında bu bağlaçlardan sonra will değil present simple kullanılır: I'll call you when I get home. (✗ when I will get)
explanation.tk:
Wagt baglaýjylary iki wakany wagt taýdan baglaýar:
• when — -anda: When I arrived, she was cooking.
• while — -ýarka (uzak dowam edýän hereket): While I was reading, the phone rang.
• before — -mazdan öň: Wash your hands before you eat.
• after — -andan soň: After he finished, he went home.
• until / till — -ýança: Wait until I come.
• as soon as — -an badyna: Call me as soon as you arrive.
Geljek manysynda bu baglaýjylardan soň will däl-de, present simple ulanylýar: I'll call you when I get home. (✗ when I will get)
explanation.ru:
Союзы времени связывают два события во времени:
• when — когда: When I arrived, she was cooking.
• while — пока, в то время как (длительное действие): While I was reading, the phone rang.
• before — перед тем как: Wash your hands before you eat.
• after — после того как: After he finished, he went home.
• until / till — до тех пор, пока: Wait until I come.
• as soon as — как только: Call me as soon as you arrive.
О будущем после этих союзов используется present simple, а не will: I'll call you when I get home. (✗ when I will get)
